# 1 Enoch Chapter 45 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 45:3 — "shall try their works" vs. "will pass judgment on their deeds"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "shall-try their-works" | Literal; Ge'ez ḥawka = to test, try, judge |
| LOGOS | "shall try their works" | Formal; "try" = judicial examination |
| PNEUMA | "will pass judgment on their deeds" | Makes the judicial sense explicit |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Shall try their works" (LOGOS). "Try" is a legal term (as in "try a case") that preserves both the judicial and evaluative senses. "Pass judgment" (PNEUMA) is too final — the Ge'ez implies a process of examination.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 45:3 — "places of rest shall be innumerable" vs. "resting places will be beyond number"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "places of-rest shall-be-innumerable" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "places of rest shall be innumerable" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "resting places will be beyond number" | Slight variation |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Places of rest shall be innumerable" (LOGOS). Minor difference; consensus holds.

**Status:** Consensus.

---

## 45:4 — "transform the heaven" vs. "transform the heavens"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "transform the-heaven" | Singular; Ge'ez samāy (singular) |
| LOGOS | "transform the heaven" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "transform the heavens" | Plural (more natural English) |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Transform the heaven" (LOGOS). The Ge'ez uses the singular, which may be deliberate. "The heaven" preserves the cosmic singularity of the transformation.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

**Total disagreements: 3**
